facts.subject: Underground Pass: traps and environment

value.wall_trap_run_through: percentage of current HP (as low as 3); standing in front repeatedly hits very fast and could be fatal
value.iban_spikes: about 5-8 each, rapid, not blocked by prayer, stun and send you back to the entrance
value.teleport: instant teleports work to leave the dungeon
value.death_penalty_note: dying during the doll step means running the whole dungeon again

facts.statement: Underground Pass damage outside fights: grid-puzzle pits always deal 15; wall traps 5-14 on a failed disarm; running through a wall trap hits a percentage of current HP (as low as 3), and standing in front of an armed trap 'will repeatedly hit very fast and could be fatal'; swinging logs 6-13; a failed Iban's Lair bridge jump deals 'up to 24 (20% + 5)' and lands you among Soulless; Iban's tomb claw 10; Iban's red spikes about 5-8 each, rapid, not blocked by prayer, with stun and return to the entrance. Any instant teleport can be used to leave. Dying during the doll step means running the whole dungeon again.
facts.caveat: The bridge figure is internally inconsistent ('up to 24' vs '20% + 5', which is about 14-15 at the owner's 48 Hitpoints); use 24 as the conservative bound. Bridge success is about 39% at Agility 1 rising linearly to 100% at 77 (Mod Ash via Bridge rev 15401279); computed for the owner's Agility 57: 39 + 56 x (117-39)/98 = about 84% per jump, so falls are likely over many jumps.

sources.title: Underground Pass
sources.quote: The grid puzzle '''always''' does 15 damage upon falling into a pit. ... #The traps can be disarmed normally, with a chance to fail and be hit for 5 to 14 damage. #Run through the traps one at a time, which hits a percentage of your current health, as low as 3.

value.no_teleport: once a flashback begins, you cannot teleport away until you finish it or die

facts.statement: Once a flashback in Icthlarin's Little Helper begins you cannot teleport away until you finish it or die. The second-flashback guardian is an apparition: Het (81, max hit 9, Slash), Apmeken (75, max hit 6, Magic) or Scabaras (75, max hit 8, Slash); Crondis (75, max hit 6, Magic) is not used for quests started after 27 April 2022. Your canopic jar decides which one, weighted by your highest of Attack/Strength, Ranged or Magic plus equipment bonuses at quest start; examine the jar before the pit jump to know.
facts.caveat: Correction to the researcher's statement ('one of four apparitions'): the quest page's jar table marks Crondis 'Unused, unless the quest was started prior to 27 April 2022', and the Apparition page says Crondis will not appear for quests started after that date, so only three are possible for a new start. The owner's highest combat stat is Ranged 56 (brief), which makes Apmeken (Magic) most likely, but not certain. The page also says logging out during a flashback places you outside the pyramid entrance, a non-teleport exit (normal logout rules in combat still apply). Klenter's Pyramid also has wall crushers, pit traps, mummies (84) and scarab swarms (2 damage plus poison); crusher damage is not quantified.

facts.subject: Agility courses (rooftops incl. Seers', Ardougne, Canifis, Pollnivneach; Colossal Wyrm) and the Hallowed Sepulchre
facts.value: UNSAFE_DEATH
facts.statement: A death on any rooftop course, on the Colossal Wyrm course or in the Hallowed Sepulchre is an official (run-ending) death on Hardcore Worlds. Hardcore Worlds use the Hardcore Group Ironman death ruleset, and none of these activities is on Jagex's safe list or the wiki's current Hardcore Worlds safe list. No Update post from 4 to 20 November 2026 adds them. The Sepulchre's item retention is an ordinary death mechanic, not a safe-death rule.
facts.caveat: T1-backed: Jagex's safe list (Castle Wars, Clan Wars, Soul Wars, Fremennik Trials 4th Koschei phase, Fight Caves and Zulrah resurrection rewards, TzHaar Fight Pit) contains no Agility activity, and the wiki's current safe list (adds boat capsizing, Emir's Arena, LMS, Pete Kayer's Challenges, Galvek and Glough replays) contains none either. Hardcore Worlds launched 2026-11-04 (new content); recheck the safe list before publishing.

facts.subject: Underground Pass traversal (for Regicide): Agility-check failures

value.rope_swing_north: up to 14 damage; you lose the rope and must climb back to the very start of the Pass
value.iban_lair_bridges: up to 24 (20% current HP + 5); you land among Soulless; success about 39% at level 1 to 100% at 77
value.middle_swamp_path: drags you down a hillside (no damage stated)
value.narrow_ledge: fail sends you back through the slave cage (no damage stated)

facts.statement: In the Underground Pass a failed north rope swing deals up to 14 damage, the rope is lost, and you must climb back to the very start of the Pass. A failed Iban's Lair bridge jump deals up to 24 (20% + 5) and drops you among the Soulless; bridge success runs from about 39% at level 1 to 100% at 77 (about 83.6% per jump at Agility 57, computed). The swamp always fails and the ledge sends you back through the slave cage. All obstacles are possible at level 1.
facts.caveat: Rope swing, bridge, ledge, swamp and level-1 statements confirmed. Computed values: 39 + 78 x 56/98 = 83.6% (Mod Ash's 39%/117% line). The '20% + 5' basis is not stated as current or max HP; 'about 14' for the owner assumes 20% of 48 HP plus 5 with unknown rounding. The swamp's 'hillside' wording comes from the dungeon page's music note ('the hillside rocky pit when falling through the swamp or rope swing'); no swamp damage is stated. Many jumps are needed, so at least one fall is likely.

updates.summary: Sailing released with four quests (Pandemonium, Prying Times, Current Affairs, Troubled Tortugans). None gives Agility or Defence XP. Sailing matters to this guide in two ways: The Graveyard (the upcoming Agility 65 course) needs Sailing 65, while the owner has 30; and the wiki lists boat capsizing as a safe death on Hardcore Worlds. No Sailing activity awarding Agility XP was found in any update in the window.

Sailing Into 2026 says the Medallion of the Deep would not get its full benefit in the Fossil Island underwater Agility/Thieving area; this was later replaced by the 80% oxygen reduction (U-013). The content itself was released later and is covered under its own items.

updates.title: Cow Boss it out today! (The Ides of Milk released) and Cow Boss and Skill Guide & Level-Up Changes (2026-03-04)
updates.summary: The Ides of Milk (Novice) has no fixed Agility or Defence XP, only a 1,000 XP combat-or-Prayer lamp. The owner has already completed it. The skill-guide change lists unlocks per level (e.g. 62 Agility).

updates.title: Gathering QoL, Trouver Changes & more! (blog); Bank Tags, Trouver System Rework & More! (released 17 June 2026)
updates.summary: Untradeables that do not 'break', such as Graceful, are no longer lost on a Wilderness death above level 20. On Hardcore Worlds this does not help: a death in the Wilderness Agility Course still ends the run unless the player Transfers.

updates.title: Summer Campfire 2026 (The Graveyard announced and polled; Wyrmscraig)
updates.summary: Official announcement of The Graveyard: requirements Sailing 65, Agility 65, Woodcutting 56 and Fletching 54, plus Olaf's Quest, The Fremennik Exiles and Pandemonium. Rewards include 35,000 Agility XP and 2 lamps of 75,000 XP each in Attack, Strength, Defence, Hitpoints or Prayer. A new 65-80 Agility course was also announced. Both poll questions passed (Upcoming updates page). The quest is unreleased: list it under upcoming only.

updates.title: The Red Reef is Out Today!
updates.summary: The Red Reef quest (no Agility or Defence XP). The Medallion of the Deep now reduces oxygen depletion by 80% in the Fossil Island underwater Agility/Thieving area, which makes that method much less demanding.

updates.title: Summer Sweep-Up 2026 (proposal blog)
updates.summary: Proposed the Sepulchre and Colossal Wyrm changes and new shortcuts, all released on 12 Aug 2026 (U-019). Listed for the audit trail only. Use the release post, not this proposal.

updates.title: The Blood Moon Rises - Out Today! (with Known Issues & Fixes, Tweaks & Fixes 2026-07-08)
updates.summary: Grandmaster Myreque finale. No fixed Agility or Defence XP, but it rewards a tome of 6 x 30,000 XP for any skill of level 70 or higher, so it could be spent on Agility after 70. The owner is far from the requirements (e.g. Slayer 74, Woodcutting 74), so it is not usable in this guide. Correction to a docs/07 lead: the 30 Jun 2026 Myreque finale is The Blood Moon Rises, not 'Sins of the Father'.

updates.title: The Blood Moon Rises & Bank Tags Tweaks
updates.summary: Bounty Hunter worlds now charge the Wilderness Agility Course fee at the entrance gate. Bounty Hunter is not accessible on Hardcore Worlds.

updates.title: Wyrmscraig Is Out Today! (Fallen From Grace); also Wyrmscraig Launches July 29!, Wyrmscraig - Activities & Lock In Poll, Wyrmscraig - Unique Rewards, Wyrmscraig & Sailing Changes, Mad Angel Combat Achievements, Meet Mortimer
updates.summary: Fallen From Grace has no Agility or Defence XP and needs Sailing 62. It recommends 54 Agility for a shortcut at the end of the quest. Wyrmscraig activities are Hunter, Crafting and Slayer. Out of reach for this account (Sailing 30).

updates.title: Summer Sweep Up - Agility & Chambers of Xeric Changes
updates.summary: The main Agility update of the window. Hallowed Sepulchre: Floor 4 now needs 77 Agility (was 82) and Floor 5 needs 87 (was 92), floor entry can be boosted, and the Grand Coffin needs 84 Thieving or 92 Agility. Colossal Wyrm course: the basic course is ~25% longer and the advanced course ~40% longer, with XP raised to keep XP/hr roughly the same at lower intensity. New shortcuts (60, 62, 79, 82, 83 relevant from 57) and barehanded grapple shortcuts (48, 52, 68, 69, 72, 78). The wiki's Colossal Wyrm page is still flagged obsolete for per-lap XP and duration.
invalidates: Hallowed Sepulchre Floor 4 requires 82 Agility (now 77, boostable)
Hallowed Sepulchre Floor 5 requires 92 Agility (now 87, boostable)
Sepulchre floor entry requirements cannot be boosted (now boostable)

Colossal Wyrm per-lap figures on the wiki (basic 504.1/633 XP, advanced 749.6/1,053.6 XP, ~1:07.8 / ~1:22.8 lap times) are from before the 12 Aug 2026 duration/XP change; per-lap XP and laps/hr must not be computed from them
Grapple shortcuts at Catherby-Taverley, Water Obelisk-Catherby, Yanille wall and Karamja volcano trees require a grapple (now usable barehanded at 68/72/69/78 Agility)

updates.title: Summer Sweep Up - Hunter & Skilling

updates.title: Summer Sweep Up Miscellaneous; Summer Sweep-Up Pet Improvements & More

updates.summary: Two small quests, neither with Agility or Defence XP. Crab Quest needs Sailing 40.

Projected rates: high intensity 65,000-75,000 XP/hr with 30+ marks/hr, assuming tick-perfect play (Jagex says most players will get less). Low intensity 55,000-60,000 XP/hr with ~14-15 marks/hr, explicitly subject to change. Also proposes a Fremennik Graceful ornament kit (65 Thieving chest) and a Graceful rework. redteam.scenario: Owner picks DP03 option C and follows the S17 prep card literally: talks to Arrg at 48/48 HP with Protect from Missiles on and runs from the arena centre to the safespot. Arrg 'primarily uses' his 38 melee (F-3089 quote) and that attack is NOT blocked by Protect from Missiles, so the prayer the card mandates protects against the less likely attack during the only phase where melee can reach. At Defence 1 a 38 lands from full HP: 48 -> 10. The card's rule is 'eat whenever HP is 30 or lower' and 'if a hit of 30+ lands before you reach the safespot, eat at once, then keep moving', with food described only as 'best healing food you have (16+)'. One ordinary food (owner Cooking 23) takes 10 HP to roughly 20-30, and the next attack 4 ticks later (attack speed 4, F-5021) is either another 38 melee (kills) or a 30 ranged that can occasionally pass prayer (kills at 30 or less). The card also sets the eat threshold at 30, which is wrong while melee can still reach: at 31-38 HP a single 38 kills. The risk officer's own verdict concedes 'no verified mitigation closes' the window, yet the step is approved and offered as option C with a card that implies it is survivable. The run's length and whether a teleport works in the arena are both undocumented (F-2036 caveat, bailout text), so the number of attacks taken during the run is unbounded by any fact.
evidence: F-5021 (Arrg max 38 slash / 30 ranged, attack speed 4, attacks at once on arrival, you take hits reaching either safespot)
F-3089 (melee is the primary attack; ranged 'significantly' more accurate; both occasionally pass protection prayers)
F-2036 (not a safe death; teleport out of arena not stated)
F-5003 (run-ending on Hardcore Worlds)
F-3021 (60 s in-combat disconnect timer)
risk.json S17 mitigations S17-M1..M4, preconditions.stop_conditions and verdict_reason ('no verified mitigation closes it')
brief.json profile: Hitpoints 48, Defence 1, Cooking 23
redteam.recommendation: Risk Officer: rewrite the S17 run phase. (1) While Arrg can still reach in melee, the eat threshold must be 38, not 30, and a single eat must be able to lift HP from 10 to 39+: require a combo-eat capable of 29+ healing in one tick-window (e.g. a hard food plus a cooked karambwan, buyable on the HW GE) and state the minimum heal per food, or state honestly that the card cannot survive two max hits and that option C relies on hit RNG during the run. (2) Decide which prayer to hold during the run from evidence (melee primary but inaccurate vs ranged accurate) and say why; switching to Protect from Missiles only once at the melee safespot is the documented logic. (3) Raise an RFI for the run length in ticks and arena teleport behaviour, and for whether an escape crystal configured to the minimum inactivity timer fires in the arena (it does not fire while moving, so it does not cover the run itself). (4) Route Strategist: DP03 option C must quote the unclosed window in its cons, not only 'most dangerous required fight'.
redteam.resolution: Re-tested 2026-11-21 on risk.json v3 (6302e5ce2c6b) and plan.json v3 (f343604e839c). S17-M1 now orders Protect from Melee on before talking to Arrg and through the run (his primary 38 melee), S17-M2 switches to Protect from Missiles only at the safespot; S17-M3 sets the run eat threshold at 38 and 34 at the safespot with a 16-heal minimum (F-4062); S17-M4 prints the honest limit (48 -> 18 -> 34 -> 4 on two max ranged hits with one eat; arithmetic checked; no verified combo-eat, run length undocumented) and a stop condition requires accepting that a correctly prepared player can die in the run. Knowledge raised to 4; RFIs for run length, arena teleport and escape crystal named. Plan DP03 option C pros now say Protect from Melee for the run and its cons quote the unclosable window (risk.json S17-M4). Published 88 headline / 55 with prep, the highest with-prep score in the plan. The remaining run-phase risk was accepted by the owner on the corrected card: ledger seq 160 (accept_risk S17, 'Keep as option (informed)').

redteam.scenario: On the default (balanced) route the owner obeys the S12 prep card, which lists a ring of life as a required item and mitigation S12-M1 'Wear a ring of life in the Koschei fight'. The wiki the card itself cites says the opposite: 'Do not wear a ring of life as you will be teleported back to your spawn point. You will need to fight him again at his first phase.' Form 4 hits 1 HP every tick and ends the fight only at 1 HP (F-5002, F-5009); a ring of life worn into form 4 fires as soon as HP falls below 10% (about 4 HP at 48 max), so the owner is teleported out and Koschei resets to form 1 every time. A literal follower cannot finish the quest while obeying the card, and every retry re-exposes him to forms 1-3, the only run-ending phases (F-5001), with no armour. The mitigation is also credited with escape -2, which drops the step's residual; that credit is invalid for form 4 and overstated for forms 1-3 (the ring cannot save from a hit that kills outright).

redteam.recommendation: Risk Officer: replace S12-M1. Either drop the ring of life, or state precisely 'wear it for forms 1-3 only and unequip it the moment form 4 begins' and justify that from a fact; re-rate escape without the -2 credit until then. Re-check the bailout text. Consider (with an RFI on scope inside the instance) an escape crystal configured to a short inactivity timer as the disconnect mitigation for forms 2-3, noting the ring-slot conflict. risk_rules: Hardcore Worlds uses the Hardcore Group Ironman death rules: treat every death as run-ending. Only Koschei's 4th form in The Fremennik Trials is a safe death on this guide's steps (F-0001, F-0004, F-5002).

Random events: a death inside one is official on Hardcore Worlds (F-0003, F-3012). The real risk is not damage on a course but accepting a teleporting event in a dangerous place (Underground Pass, Isafdar, Trollheim, the Rellekka road, Darkmeyer): per the Red Team's reading of the current Random events page (rev 15407277; not yet a verified fact) you come back to the same tile among the same monsters, and an event window opened mid-fight costs attention. Always dismiss random events in quest steps and dangerous areas; never accept one there. On rooftops, dismiss them too; HP level does not change this risk.
Never go AFK on any course; break sessions into blocks of an hour or less.

Rooftops with unpublished fail damage (Canifis, Seers', Ardougne): no source says a fail there cannot exceed current HP, so the guide does not claim it. Conservative rule, not a sourced bound: eat whenever HP is 30 or lower, never attempt a failable obstacle below 20 HP, and stop and ask for a re-rating after any single fail above 12 (F-5367, F-5368, F-5369, F-3074, F-3080). Pollnivneach's stall formula is lethal at 2 HP or less (F-3075): never attempt it below 10 HP.

Escape crystal (one free per character, F-3016): carry it, configured to a short inactivity timer (2-300 s; it fires when you take damage after that much inactivity, and at once on damage just after login or a world hop, F-3017). Where it works, a disconnect produces exactly that condition, so it can be disconnect cover. Its documented scope is a list of minigames; in this guide's instances and open-world fights its behaviour is undocumented, so no step credits it. It never fires while you are moving (F-3018), so it does not cover runs such as Arrg's. Worn, it acts like a ring of life (F-0015). Exception: BANK it before the Koschei duel and never wear a ring of life there (worn, it resets the fight to form 1, F-5011; carried, it can fire if you stand still in form 4 and restart the fight at form 1, F-3017, F-5009). Its status-clearing is only announced (F-3020). Never lower another precaution because of it.

Never step into the Wilderness: no Wilderness Agility Course, no West Ardougne lever, no Ice Plateau tablets. Wilderness PvP is live on Hardcore Worlds and a PK death is official (F-5366, F-4091, F-3011).
Never use the Werewolf Agility Course at current Hitpoints and Strength (F-3067, F-3068).

No player-owned house, Nightmare Zone or Rogues' Den maze: all are unsafe deaths on Hardcore Worlds. Set house teleports to 'Outside'; buy Graceful from Grace without entering the maze (F-4003, F-3013, F-5358, F-4016, F-5007).
Desert: travel by magic carpet with waterskins; never walk south of Pollnivneach or along the River Elid (crocodiles, heat) (F-3078, F-5373, F-3054).
Never drink a poison chalice for a boost: it can deal 49 damage against 48 HP (F-5352).

In any quest fight, have the correct protection prayer on before the fight starts and keep at least 20 prayer points; a disconnect leaves you in combat for up to 60 seconds and logout needs 9.6 s since the last hit (F-3021, F-3022).

Against any attacker that hits 38 (Troll generals, Arrg), eat whenever HP is 38 or lower while it can reach you; the largest verified single heal is 16 (monkfish, F-4062) and no combo-eat is verified, so two max hits can outpace eating (F-5018, F-5021).

Defence (cap 50): never put any lamp, tome or choosable reward into Defence. Black Knights' Fortress (S19) lamps list Defence as a valid choice: show it with a 'never' marker (F-2015). Forced Defence XP: The Fremennik Trials 2,812.4 (Defence 16, F-2038); the long-term Sins of the Father chain adds 4,600 more (F-2101, F-2132), Defence 24 in total (tools/xp.py), still under 50.

Brand-new content (The Writing's on the Wall, Hardcore Worlds rules) is volatile: re-check the walkthrough and the Hardcore Worlds safe list before acting on this guide after any game update (F-2006, F-0017).

Informed policy: every step is shown with its HEADLINE (unmitigated, game-relative, like-for-like with the ladder) and its 'with prep' residual, its necessity label and, from a headline of 45, its full prep card (mitigations, minimum HP, stop conditions, bail-out). Hazard-flag floors apply after calibration. Nothing is hidden for danger alone.

Two former steps stay vetoed and are no longer in the plan; they may be shown only as blocked long-term options: Werewolf course (unverifiable_mechanic: deathslide maximum unsourced; lifts at Agility 81+/Strength 81+/under 2 kg, or with a sourced maximum) and Sins of the Father (insufficient_facts_for_prep: boss max hits and teleport rules unresearched; lifts after an RFI and re-rating). S17 Troll Romance (unclosed run window, stated on its card) and S25 Hallowed Sepulchre (needs Sins of the Father and 70+ Hitpoints) are approved with conditions.
assumptions: Start: Agility 57 with 212,733 XP (Hardcore Worlds hiscores, brief). Hiscores refresh on logout, so in-game XP may be slightly higher; the calculator starts from 212,733.

XP/h choices inside fact ranges (low end unless noted, because the owner plays semi-attentively and the rates include fails): Canifis 14,000 (F-1004: 14,000-19,700); Falador 27,200 (F-1010: 27,200-35,000); Seers' 40,000 (F-1017 no-teleport 40,000-44,000; its caveat warns that laps while still failing at 60-65 may be slower, 27,000-37,000); Pollnivneach 47,000 (F-1028 no diary 47,000-51,000); Rellekka 50,000 (F-1035 no diary 50,000-55,052); Ardougne 66,000 (F-1041: 66,000-70,184); Sepulchre to Floor 4: 73,000 (F-1058: 73,000-81,000).
Seers' 70-80 (S26, decision-point option only) uses the 60-70 figure of 40,000 (F-1017); this is an extrapolation and probably conservative because fails stop at 79.
Per-lap XP: Pollnivneach 890 and Rellekka 780 are the no-diary values (F-1027, F-1034). The owner has no achievement diaries (brief), so diary variants are never used.
The hard Kandarin diary is impossible for this zerker (Piety task needs Defence 70, F-1021/F-2621), so Seers' is planned without the Seers' bank teleport; Camelot tablets land at Camelot (F-5347).

Quest steps have no est_hours because no verified fact gives quest durations, so the calculator counts 0 hours for every quest: route totals understate the real time of quest-heavy routes (the balanced route).

Defence (cap 50, build profile): only The Fremennik Trials adds Defence on any route (2,812.4, F-2038), taking the balanced route to Defence 16 (tools/xp.py); the safest route adds 0. All other routed quests give 0 fixed Defence XP (cited per step). Every lamp or tome in this plan is assigned to Agility or a non-Defence skill; the Black Knights' Fortress, Graveyard and similar combat lamps must never go to Defence. Monkey Madness I's Daero training (35,000 or 20,000 Defence) is not part of any route (F-2085). Long term (DP07 option B, not routed), the Sins of the Father chain adds 4,600 forced Defence XP (Nature Spirit 2,000, In Search of the Myreque 600, In Aid of the Myreque 2,000; F-2132), taking Defence to about 24 with The Fremennik Trials (7,412.4 XP, tools/xp.py): 26 levels of headroom under the cap of 50 remain.

Thieving: Thieving 24 is at least 7,028 XP; with The Writing's on the Wall's 2,500 Thieving XP (F-0032) it is at least 9,528 XP = level 26 (tools/xp.py). Death on the Isle's Thieving 34 (20,224 XP) still needs training.

Secondary quest XP that no fact holds as a numeric value is named in step rationales but not carried as xp_rewards numbers: Icthlarin's Little Helper (Thieving 4,500, Woodcutting 4,000; F-2061), Underground Pass (Attack 3,000; F-2045), Troll Romance (Strength 4,000; F-2032), Recruitment Drive (Prayer and Herblore 1,000.5; F-2010), Death on the Isle (Thieving 10,000, Crafting 5,000; F-2502), and the eight unnamed non-Agility, non-Defence skills of The Fremennik Trials (F-2038). Each of those facts confirms 0 (or, for The Fremennik Trials, the carried 2,812.4) Defence XP, so the Defence-cap tracking is complete.
